rows.label: tlk46300077_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Welcome to Acedia. Whether you're here
for sightseeing or business, Acedia
welcomes everyone.

rows.label: tlk46300077_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Tensions between Invidia and Superbia
continue, but it's safe here.

rows.label: tlk46300077_01_msg0003
rows.name:
The cathedral, where His Holiness
Malbeni resides, is just up those
steps.

rows.label: tlk46300077_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Stop by Poldis Circle en route.
You can buy all kinds of
Acedian specialties there.
